ctx.x: S.B. Foster. We used to call him 'High C' Foster. Yeah. And, going out on parade one day, when he came back after the parade, he took me and put me on trumpet. Before that, he used to come over my house like 5:00 in the morning and knock on the window. My mother would wake me up and say Professor Foster's out there waiting for you.
